oracles: PROXY accepted from an untrusted source -> red (PROXY-1)
peer address taken from PROXY when untrusted -> red (PROXY-2)
v1 header accepted / declared len 537 accepted -> red (PROXY-3)
unknown SNI routed to a default upstream -> red (L4-1)
L4 bytes parsed as HTTP (a request line on an L4 listener gets an HTTP response) -> red (L4-2)

acceptance.must: red before P7-wire-001/P7-bin-001 (subject lacks the features); spec vectors from haproxy proxy-protocol.txt §2.2 (TCP4, TCP6, UNIX, LOCAL, TLVs incl. CRC32C and SSL), >=200 hostile headers, trusted-CIDR matrix, L4 SNI routing to two upstreams via openssl/ python ssl clients, PROXY+L4 combined; admission/audit see the PROXY source address

notes: Python stdlib only for the sender; upstreams are local echo/TLS servers.
